messages:
oliver_billing: Hey team, FYI invoice for ACME (Mar 2026, invoice #ACME-0326) shows a ~45% overage charge on their Dedicated commit. They were on a 2x reserved commit and we billed burst on top. Can we reconcile why the dedicated pool counted as burst?

maria_finance: Ugh. Can you paste the invoice line and usage table? I can start a true-up but need a root cause to request SLA credit. :eyes:

oliver_billing: Copied the relevant lines: 
```
line 42: dedicated-commit-acme 2x reserved - $12,000
line 43: dedicated-burst-overage 3rd-party-pool - $5,420
summary: total billed $17,420
```
Looks like 3rd-party-pool attributed traffic despite their app being pinned to dedicated.

sam_eng: tagging in — we had a routing fix rolled last week (deploy-bot shows rollback on 2026-03-09). There was a brief policy mismatch where smart-routing sent overflow to shared pool for 7h. That should have been covered by their commit (we should've drained their queue to reserved nodes). I'll pull request logs.

maria_finance: If overflow happened, per our billing rules overflow -> burst charges. But given it's our routing bug, we should offer a credit. Can you confirm duration/requests? I need request numbers to calculate credit % for finance approval.

sam_eng: Quick summary from logs: ~18m tokens/min avg during the window, ~1.2M tokens total routed to shared pool. I'll export the request IDs. Likely ~31% of that day's token usage.

june_sales: ACME sent a note to their CSM, they're upset. Can we fast-track a provisional credit while we investigate? They requested a true-up and an explanation.

maria_finance: Yes I can approve a provisional holdback credit up to $4,000 pending final reconciliation, but need signoff from legal if >$3k for contract exceptions. Oliver, can you prepare the credit memo?

oliver_billing: Will draft. Proposed steps: 1) provisional credit $3,500, 2) formal root-cause with eng timeline, 3) final true-up adjustment on next invoice. Sound OK?

sam_eng: Sounds good. Also pushing a quick mitigation: pin routing policy for ACME to 'force-dedicated' flag and add health-check to avoid evicting their tasks. I'll open a rollout PR and add the audit log entries.

billing-bot: [system] incident deploy rollback detected: deploy-2026-03-09T04:12Z -> affected routing policy 'smart-routing-v3'.

maria_finance: OK move forward. Oliver: include SR case # and provisional credit line on the ledger as "ACME provisional true-up". Use GL code: BILL-CR-OVR. I will loop in legal for the +$500 excepetion.

oliver_billing: Created draft memo and added ledger hold. Sending to @maria_finance and @june_sales for review. Will notify ACME with provisional credit ETA 48h.

june_sales: Thanks — I'll reply to the customer with the plan and timeline. Please cc me on the final memo. :thumbsup:

maria_finance: Once we have final token counts from Sam, I'll run the exact math and request the formal credit. Good catch.

sam_eng: Exported request IDs to the ticket, included sample request traces. Will follow up if we find any other customers impacted during the same window.

oliver_billing: Closing loop here — provisional credit set, tracking ticket updated: FIN-4521. Will update thread when final true-up posts.
